# WSIMOD: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

WSIMOD 0.8.1's daily step, transcribed: a WSIMOD `config.yml` as a noodl `Model` whose closure runs WSIMOD's day bitwise, batched and differentiable. How the pieces fit together: [WSIMOD](../applications/wsimod.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Using noodl](../usage.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.wsimod`. The full reference, with every parameter, is in the [API reference](../api.md).

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `build_model` | ``(model, state, drivers)`` for a WSIMOD configuration (``read_wsimod_config``). | `build_model(network, *, pollutants=True)` |
| `initial_drivers` | The configured drivers (``model.driver_template``, D6), then ``values`` by key and row label. | `initial_drivers(model, *, values=None)` |
| `initial_state` | The configuration's state (``WsimodDay.initial_state``), then ``values`` by key and row label (D10): ``{"wsimod.storage": {("river", "tank"): 9.0}}``. | `initial_state(model, *, values=None)` |

## Network components

Descriptions of the physical objects a network is built from.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `WsimodNetwork` | A WSIMOD model description: pollutants, orchestration, dates, nodes and arcs, in the configuration's order (a node's in- and out-arc order is the arcs' order). | `WsimodNetwork(pollutants, float_accuracy, orchestration, dates, date_labels, nodes, arcs)` |

## Closures

Functions of the state that compute drivers each step (densities, flows, levels).

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `WsimodDay` | WSIMOD 0.8.1's daily step as an integrating closure (spec, The daily driver). | `WsimodDay(network, *, pollutants)` |

## Files

Readers and writers of other tools' file formats.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `read_wsimod_config` | Read a WSIMOD model description. | `read_wsimod_config(source, *, config_name='config.yml', overrides=None)` |

## Other classes

Supporting types.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `DayRecord` | What one day records (``model.py:1063-1170``), at the state the day reached, before ``end_timestep``; every tensor has the day's batch shape in front. | `DayRecord(arc_flow, arc_quality, tank_storage, tank_quality, surface, surface_quality, terms, dropped, dropped_arcs, storage_total, storage_start, events, maxiter, decisions)` |
| `WsimodMassBalance` | The system's water balance per day, each ``(..., T, 1 + K_additive)`` (volume, then the additive pollutants' masses). ``terms`` holds every term by its ``"<Class>.<term>"`` key (D11) plus ``"dropped"``; ``residual = inflow - outflow - storage_change``. | `WsimodMassBalance(inflow, outflow, storage_change, residual, terms, dropped_arcs=None)` |
| `WsimodResults` | What WSIMOD's ``Model.run`` records (``model.py:1063-1170``), with a leading batch shape. | `WsimodResults(dates, arc_names, arc_flow, arc_quality, tank_names, tank_storage, tank_quality, surface_names, surface, surface_quality, mass_balance)` |

## Functions

Calculations and helpers.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `wsimod_run` | Run ``model`` over its dates, or the first ``days`` of them (``1 <= days <= len(dates)``), and record each day (module text). | `wsimod_run(model, state=None, drivers=None, *, days=None, diagnostics=None)` |
